metadata.question: Did the city region increase in Orlando Florida from 1973 to 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Landsat collection for long-term urban change (1973-2014) - Landsat 1-5 MSS for 1973, Landsat 8 OLI for 2014 - Location: Orlando, Florida (approximately -81.38, 28.54) 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud masking for better urban area detection - Use NDVI or urban indices to identify built-up areas - Built-up areas typically have low NDVI and high built-up index values 3. Logic: - Calculate urban/built-up area for both years - Compare the total urban area (pixel count or area) - Valid result: Urban area increase = A, decrease/same = B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels after masking), C3 (calculation errors) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Orlando, Florida region const orlando = ee.Geometry.Point([-81.38, 28.54]); const region = orlando.buffer(20000); // 20km radius around Orlando // 1973 - Landsat 1-3 MSS let col1973 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM01/C02/T1') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1973-01-01', '1973-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let size1973 = col1973.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1973 Images: ${size1973}`); if (size1973 === 0) { // Try Landsat 2 or 3 col1973 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM02/C02/T1') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('1973-01-01', '1975-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); size1973 = col1973.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1973 Images (extended): ${size1973}`); if (size1973 === 0) { console.log('No data for 1973'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 2014 - Landsat 8 OLI let col2014 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2014-01-01', '2014-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let size2014 = col2014.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2014 Images: ${size2014}`); if (size2014 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2014'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Process 1973 data - MSS bands (green, red, NIR1, NIR2) const img1973 = col1973.median(); const ndvi1973 = img1973.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B2']); // NIR1, Red for MSS const urban1973 = ndvi1973.lt(0.2); // Low NDVI indicates urban // Process 2014 data - OLI bands const img2014 = col2014.median(); const ndvi2014 = img2014.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']); // NIR, Red for OLI const urban2014 = ndvi2014.lt(0.2); // Low NDVI indicates urban // Calculate urban area (pixel count) const count1973 = urban1973.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B2').getInfo(); const count2014 = urban2014.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B4').getInfo(); console.log(`1973 Urban pixels: ${count1973}`); console.log(`2014 Urban pixels: ${count2014}`); // Validation if (count1973 === null || count2014 === null || count1973 === undefined || count2014 === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (count1973 === 0 && count2014 === 0) { console.log('No valid urban pixels detected'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Compare urban area const increase = count2014 > count1973; const percentChange = ((count2014 - count1973) / count1973 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Urban area change: ${percentChange}%`); if (increase) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
